## Release Notes

## Walkthrough

This PR introduces a `--fast-forward` flag for development mode that enables simulated slot advancement instead of wall-clock timing in block authorship. The flag is parsed from CLI arguments, propagated through JamConfig and configuration objects, and implements conditional logic in the block authorship worker to support rapid iteration in dev environments. Additionally, a new tiny-network script is added to spawn and manage a small 6-node JAM network locally with optional fast-forward mode support.
